clues.text: Riders stay right-side up with zero inversions on this coaster, which tops out at a height of 60 feet and hits a top speed of 55 mph.
Built by the legendary manufacturer Arrow, this classic ride first welcomed guests in 1988.
This coaster can be found in California, where it flies through the trees in the Samurai Summit section of the park.
Among the remaining classic swinging models in North America, this ride holds the distinction of being the only Arrow Dynamics suspended coaster west of the Mississippi River.
The ride gets its title from the stealthy, shadow-dwelling covert agents and martial artists of feudal Japan.

evidence.quote: The coaster is located in the Samurai Summit area of Six Flags Magic Mountain in Valencia, California.
Ninja is the only Arrow Dynamics suspended coaster west of the Mississippi River.
